segments.name: Biopharma
segments.description: Develops and potentially commercializes innovative immunology therapeutics for autoimmune and inflammatory diseases.
segments.evidence: Our Biopharma segment focuses on the development and potential commercialization of innovative immunology therapeutics for autoimmune and inflammatory diseases

segments.name: Royalty Management
segments.description: Manages the financial collaborations for Jemperli from GSK and imsidolimab from Vanda, focused on royalty value.
segments.evidence: our Royalty Management segment manages the financial collaboration for Jemperli from GSK and for imsidolimab from Vanda.

revenueModel.text: The company recognizes revenue from milestones and royalties under its immuno-oncology collaboration with GSK and license and transition services revenue from its collaboration with Vanda.
revenueModel.evidence: We currently recognize revenue from milestones and royalties achieved under our immuno-oncology collaboration with GSK and license and transition services revenue from our collaboration with Vanda.

changes.text: In fiscal year 2025, in connection with the planned separation of the businesses, the company updated its segment reporting to two operating segments: Biopharma and Royalty Management.
changes.evidence: As a result of these changes, we updated our segment reporting to reflect two operating segments: Biopharma and Royalty Management.
